description: This file defines the RowsRenderer class responsible for rendering table rows into RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering framework. It contains methods for calculating indentation and rendering row properties related to borders and alignment.

classes.name: RowsRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a Table Rows object into RTF format, handling indentation and border styling.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the row, particularly setting the left indentation in RTF format.

methods.name: CalculateLeftIndent
methods.description: Calculates the left indentation for a set of rows based on the table's columns and cell border styles.
